verdict_reason: Automatic first pass. The video's sum shows +£1,192 a month. You would put in about £128 a month (your limit is £400); a weak year would need £234. 11 of the 11 nearby Airbnbs take enough to keep you inside it. After 25 years the flat is yours and should then pay you about £90 a month. The price itself could not be checked: there is no reliable evidence of what flats sell for in this neighbourhood, so find that out from local agents before offering.
